answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the comet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the spiral of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the bridge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
